text: A company uses Power Automate to manage work orders. When a new work order is created, a service manager must review and approve the request before a field technician can be assigned. Which type of flow should you use to automate this process?
explanation: An approval flow is specifically designed to handle scenarios where something needs to be reviewed and approved before the next step can happen. In your case, when a work order is created, the flow can automatically send an approval request to the service manager. Once the manager approves it, the flow can proceed to dispatch the worker.
